name: Melbourne
tagline: Coffee Culture, Sports Obsessed, and Endlessly Livable
description: Melbourne consistently ranks among the world's most livable cities, and for good reason. The city offers an extraordinary food and coffee scene, world-class sports events (Australian Open, F1, AFL), vibrant arts and music, and a relaxed yet cosmopolitan atmosphere. While housing costs are significant and the overall cost of living is high by global standards, Melbourne rewards residents with excellent public services, some of the world's best hospitals and specialists (budgets here assume private visitor health cover, since non-resident retirees don't qualify for Medicare), and a quality of life that few cities can match.

quickFacts.visa: Visitor visa (Subclass 600) allows stays up to 12 months. Investor Retirement visa (Subclass 405) closed to new applicants. Significant Investor visa requires A$5M+ investment. No easy retirement pathway — most retirees use long-stay tourist visas.
quickFacts.safetyRating: High – safe with typical urban precautions
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with warm summers and cool winters; famously changeable weather

housing.description: Studio or small 1BR in an outer-west/north suburb near a train line (Footscray, Sunshine, Reservoir, Preston)

dining.description: Cheap eats on Lygon Street or Victoria Street; coffee shop culture 3-4x/week

healthcare.description: Basic/mid Overseas Visitor Health Cover for an early retiree (~50) — private cover, as a non-resident is not covered by Medicare

transportation.description: Myki card for tram, train, and bus; free tram zone in CBD

entertainment.description: Free galleries at NGV, beach trips to St Kilda, park barbecues, street art walks

1M.lifestyle: A workable but disciplined Melbourne life in an outer-west or northern suburb — Footscray, Sunshine, Reservoir — a studio or small one-bedroom near a train line, with most meals cooked at home and supplemented by the city's superb multicultural cheap eats. Medicare does not apply to a non-resident, so genuine private cover is carried. The free tram zone, free galleries at the NGV, and St Kilda's beaches keep leisure affordable; the famously changeable weather and gray winters are the main adjustment.

housing.description: Standalone 1BR in Brunswick, Coburg, Northcote, or Yarraville

dining.description: Regular dining in Melbourne's laneway restaurants, brunch culture, wine bars

healthcare.description: Comprehensive Overseas Visitor Health Cover plus extras for an early retiree — private cover, not Medicare

transportation.description: Myki pass plus occasional car-share or ride-hail; weekend drives on the Great Ocean Road

entertainment.description: AFL season tickets, comedy festival shows, gym membership, Yarra Valley wine trips

2M.lifestyle: A standalone one-bedroom in Brunswick, Coburg, or Yarraville — real neighborhoods with character — with regular dining across Melbourne's laneways, AFL games at the MCG, and a Myki pass topped up with occasional car-share for Great Ocean Road weekends. Comprehensive private health cover sits on top of the budget. Melbourne's food, coffee, and cultural scene deliver a genuinely rich daily life at a cost that stays reasonable.

housing.description: Nice 1BR in Fitzroy, Carlton, Richmond, or South Yarra

dining.description: Fine dining at hatted restaurants like Attica and Gimlet, regular wine bar visits, hosted dinner parties

healthcare.description: Premium private health insurance with top hospital choice and comprehensive extras

transportation.description: Owned car for regional trips, Myki for city travel, occasional domestic flights

entertainment.description: Australian Open tickets, F1 Grand Prix, premium gym, sailing on Port Phillip Bay

3M.lifestyle: A nice one-bedroom in Fitzroy, Carlton, or South Yarra puts the best of inner Melbourne within walking distance. Dining at hatted restaurants, Australian Open and Grand Prix tickets, a car for Mornington Peninsula and Yarra Valley trips, and premium private health insurance are all comfortably affordable. Melbourne's cultural depth supports this level of spending easily.

housing.description: Modern large 1BR or compact 2BR in South Yarra/Richmond or a premium CBD tower

dining.description: Regular dining at Melbourne's best restaurants, private chef, exclusive wine club memberships

healthcare.description: Top-tier private insurance with concierge GP service and international coverage

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle, premium insurance, occasional first-class domestic flights

entertainment.description: Corporate box at MCG, Australian Open platinum passes, yacht club membership, art collecting

luxuryExtras.description: Mornington Peninsula weekends, first-class travel, premium wine cellar, philanthropy

5M.lifestyle: A modern large one-bedroom or compact two-bedroom in South Yarra, Richmond, or a premium CBD tower, regular dining at the city's best tables, a luxury car, and a weekly housekeeper. Corporate-box access at the MCG and Rod Laver Arena, business-class domestic flights, and a premium international health plan define an affluent life in one of the world's most livable cities.

housing.description: Luxury CBD/Southbank penthouse or a Toorak/Brighton prestige apartment

dining.description: Personal chef, private dining at Australia's finest restaurants, catered events at home

healthcare.description: VIP concierge medicine with international network access and executive wellness programs

transportation.description: One luxury vehicle, a driver when wanted, and first-class international travel

entertainment.description: Private boxes at MCG and Rod Laver Arena, art patronage, yacht ownership, international events

domesticHelp.description: Regular housekeeping plus occasional part-time help

luxuryExtras.description: Vineyard investment in Yarra Valley, first-class international travel, fine art, philanthropy

10M.lifestyle: A luxury CBD or Southbank penthouse, or a Toorak/Brighton prestige apartment, with regular housekeeping, a driver when wanted, and first-class international travel. Private boxes at the MCG and Rod Laver Arena, concierge and international-plus-evacuation health cover, and dining anywhere in the city without a second thought. Melbourne is expensive enough that even this budget is absorbed more fully than in a smaller city — the lifestyle is less about visible flash than about convenience and never weighing a cost.
